text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and D for gains felt good, but buying them back later at higher prices showed me that a gain alone is not a useful sell signal; I should decide based on current prospects and portfolio fit.","I should not treat each stock as a separate scorecard or let purchase price dictate my next move. I’ll reassess winners and losers by the same standards, without avoiding a sale just to escape regret.","I traded rarely while the account fluctuated, and those short-term moves offered no reliable forecast. I’ll keep decisions deliberate, consider diversification and risk, and avoid reacting to price changes alone."]}
